task: Generate independent positions, ideas, concerns, questions, unknowns, and one surprise about whether automatic conflict resolution is the right intervention.
challenge: A proposed AI family scheduler would automatically resolve conflicts among changing commitments.
current_problem_frame: Families may struggle to discover, reconcile, and assign ownership for commitments arriving through fragmented channels.

known_evidence.claim: Commitments arrive through email, texts, school applications, and paper.

assumptions.statement: Families want an AI system to resolve conflicts automatically.
Scheduling, rather than discovery or decision ownership, is the primary problem.

unknowns: Who currently performs the invisible coordination work?
Which conflict decisions can safely be delegated?
What happens when the system has incomplete information?
constraints: No completed human interviews are available.
Keep the next experiment reversible and low cost.
